summary: Tested the CC restriction bug fix. MAIN BUG FIXED: Feed no longer breaks when join fails with 403 CC error. NEW ISSUE FOUND: Alert.alert() is a no-op in react-native-web, so the user doesn't see any feedback when join fails.

ui_bugs.issue: Alert.alert() from react-native is a no-op on web (react-native-web). When user tries to join a route with insufficient CC, the join fails silently with no visual feedback to the user.
ui_bugs.root_cause: react-native-web Alert implementation is: static alert() {} - empty function
ui_bugs.suggested_fix: Use a web-compatible alert solution like: (1) Custom modal component, (2) Toast/snackbar component, (3) window.alert() fallback for web, or (4) Check Platform.OS === 'web' and use window.alert() directly

action_items: CRITICAL: Implement web-compatible alert for CC restriction errors. Options: (1) Use window.alert() on web: if (Platform.OS === 'web') window.alert(message) else Alert.alert(title, message), (2) Create custom Toast/Modal component that works on both platforms, (3) Use a library like react-native-toast-message that has web support
